name: singlet_spatial_preproc_bin_to_cell_aggregation
title: Aggregate sub-cellular bins into cell-like units
description: Assigns sub-cellular bins (2 um Visium HD grid) to cell-like or nucleus-like analysis units using a nucleus or cell prior, then writes a bin-to-unit map and a unit-by-gene count table. The default method, nucleus_expansion, follows bin2cell's distance rule with expression tie-breaking. Use it to turn a bin grid into units before cell-level analysis; do not use it on dissociated or already cell-level data, or to segment images.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI with bin counts, bin centroids and a registered prior.

method.description: Grouping method; nucleus_expansion is the proposed default, and bin2cell wraps the published tool.

prior_source.description: Prior from labels/ (nuclei) or shapes/ (cell polygons).

bin_size_um.description: Nominal bin side in microns; sets unit area and must match the bin grid.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without computing units.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

nucleus_expansion.description: Options for nucleus_expansion and bin2cell; other methods ignore them.

max_bin_distance.description: Maximum bin-grid distance an expanded label may travel from its nucleus.

tie_k.description: Candidate hits queried per bin; ambiguous bins are resolved among them.

tie_pca_components.description: PCA components for the expression distance used to break ties.

sopa_bins.description: Options for sopa_bins; other methods ignore them.

expand_radius_ratio.description: Fraction of mean cell radius by which prior polygons are expanded before containment.

no_overlap.description: If true, shared bins go to one cell by nearest unique-profile centroid.

pca_components.description: PCA components for the shared-bin distance.

proseg.description: Options for proseg, a comparator; other methods ignore them.

ncomponents.description: Negative-binomial mixture components for cell expression.

diffusion_probability.description: Prior probability that a transcript is diffused and repositioned.

fixed_grid.description: Options for fixed_grid; other methods ignore them.

block_um.description: Side of each grid unit in microns; must be a multiple of bin_size_um. Units are not cells.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obs/unit_id. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: For completed runs: method, n_bins, n_units, unassigned_bin_fraction, multi_assigned_bin_fraction, median_unit_area_um2. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
